about_the_game:
Help the Capybara Survive

You are an adorable Capybara, kidnapped by poachers, who woke up in a terrifying laboratory... not in reality, but in Limbo! Now you are a transparent ghost, and to return to your friends, you must overcome nightmarish traps, cunning challenges, and the dark secrets of this place.

KAPIBAROV is a hardcore platformer with soul and spikes. Here, every trap is not just an obstacle, but a treacherous enemy that lurks in the most unexpected places, shoots from the darkness, or chases you relentlessly. Even seemingly harmless spikes can suddenly come to life, and saws can appear where you least expect them. The game's world literally wants you dead... but that's what makes every success so sweet!

But it's not all gloom! With every victory, the Capybara's world will come alive and fill with color. Modifiers not only make the game more challenging but also paint the levels according to the chosen trial. And to face death in style, you can choose unique skins for your Capybara.

Death with Character

Prepare for a generous dose of spikes that shoot toward the ceiling, saws that chase you down, and "friendly" platforms that vanish under your feet. Every trap is designed to surprise and... kill.

Currency of Death: Each failed attempt is not just pain but a valuable resource. Spend accumulated deaths on Anti-Boosters: they won't help you but will only make things worse. But be careful: if you're too stingy, the final boss will use your unspent deaths against you! So, you'll have to find a balance between pain and suffering.

Key Features

  • Devious Level Design: Forget simple jumps. Here, every platform is a trick, every spike is a traitor, and saws fly in swarms. The levels constantly throw new ways to destroy you.

  • Insane Modifiers: Want to make your already tough life even harder? Activate mods! Flip the world upside down, make all surfaces devilishly slippery, or enable even more treacherous options. Perfect for masochists and those seeking a new challenge.

  • Boosters and Anti-Boosters: Some will aid your progress, while others will make it harder but erase a portion of your accumulated deaths.

  • Capybara in Style: Choose not just a look, but a tactic. Unique costumes offer not only a cool appearance but also special bonuses to help you outsmart traps.

  • A World That Comes Alive: Begin your journey in a grim, monochrome Limbo. With every level completed and every pain overcome, the world will gradually fill with color, symbolizing your hope of returning home.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X (2 ГБ VRAM)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: KAPIBAROV is a brutal yet fair hardcore platformer with a unique death mechanic, devious traps, and the touching story of a ghost capybara. Get ready to die, learn, and conquer!
